services.desc: Bogan’s Deep Sea Fishing Center offers a wide variety of deep sea fishing and party boat fishing trips in New Jersey, targeting seasonal species throughout the year. From Sea Bass, Porgies, Fluke, Ling, Cod, and Striped Bass to offshore canyon Tuna trips, our fleet sailing from Brielle, NJ provides daily fishing opportunities along the Jersey Shore. Each trip offers a different experience-from inshore and bottom fishing to offshore canyon runs-with options for anglers of all experience levels. blurb: Guests fish from party boats and offshore vessels targeting species such as squid, porgy, tilefish, tuna, bonito, albacore, blackfish, and ling. Trips vary seasonally and include inshore and offshore fishing with techniques like jigging, trolling, and deep-drop fishing. Multiple boats operate from Bogan's Basin, including the Big Jamaica, 100' Paramount, and Jamaica II.
